αἰθούσῃ: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnaded hall; fem. dat. sg.
αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., intensive with σφίσι: ’for themselves’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: αὐτοῖς ὀβελοῖσιν ’the very spits’ · also plain dat. pl. pronoun, unemphatic: ’to them’ (αὐτοῖς μετέειπον ’spoke among them’)
αὐτῇσιν: αὐτός — self; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic αὐταῖς), used as a plain pronoun: ’to them’
βαθυζώνους: βαθύζωνος — deep-girdled (wearing a long, girdled robe); stock epithet of women; fem. acc. pl.
γεγαῶτα: γίγνομαι — be born, come to be; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., epic γεγαώς (= Attic γεγονώς): ’born’, with νέον ’newly born’
γουνούμενος: γουνόομαι — supplicate, entreat (lit. clasp by the knees, γόνυ); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
δάκρυσι: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. dat. pl. (from the athematic stem δάκρυ-)
δάμασον: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, tame, master; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δάμη: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδάμη): ’was laid low’
δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
δαίνυνθ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυνθ’ = δαίνυντο), τ>θ before rough breathing: ’they feasted’
δαῖτ: δαίς — feast, meal; acc. sg., elided (δαῖτ’ = δαῖτα)
διδοῖ: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δίδωσι)
δμῳάς: δμῳή — female slave, maidservant (Attic δούλη); fem. acc. pl.
δώρων: δῶρον — gift; neut. gen. pl., partitive with κειμήλια: ’of the gifts’ · also gen. pl. after εἵνεκα: ’of gifts’ (γυναίων εἵνεκα δώρων ’on account of women’s gifts’)
εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
εὐερκέος: εὐερκής — well-fenced, strongly walled; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with αὐλῆς
εὐρυχόροιο: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-grounds, spacious; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
εὐχωλῇς: εὐχωλή — prayer, vow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic εὐχαῖς; Ionic η for α)
θάλαμος: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. nom. sg.
θαλέθοντες: θαλέθω — bloom, flourish; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’in full bloom’
θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
κάκιον: κακός — bad, evil; comparative κακίων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’worse’
κέλαδον: κέλαδος — din, clamour, noise; masc. acc. sg.
καθεζομένη: καθέζομαι — sit down, perch; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.
καλλικόμοιο: καλλίκομος — with fair hair; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Ἑλένης
κατέλεξεν: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. 3 sg.: ’recounted, told in full’
κελοίμην: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential after ἄν: ’I would bid’
κεχολωμένος: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’enraged’
κεχολῶσθαι: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. mid. inf. (κεχόλωμαι ’be angry’): ’to be angry, be in a rage’
κολλητὰς: κολλητός — glued, closely joined (κολλάω); fem. acc. pl.
κούρας: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. acc. pl., Ionic/epic (= Attic κόρας)
κούρῃσιν: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic κόραις)
κρινάμενος: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out (for himself)’
λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’ · also pres. inf. as a complement in apposition after δοάσσατο κέρδιον εἶναι: ’to beseech’
λαθὼν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. + acc.: ’escaping the notice of’
λιποίμην: λείπω — leave; mid. be left behind; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I should be left behind’
μέγαρα: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. acc. pl.
μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’alone’
νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νηλές); cf. dat. νηλέι
νόει: νοέω — perceive, take in, understand; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’think, mark’
νύμφης: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. gen. sg.
οἰνοπέδοιο: οἰνόπεδος — wine-bearing, planted with vines; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
οἴῃ: οἶος — alone, only; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic μόνῃ): ’to her alone’
οὐκέθ: οὐκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (οὐκέθ’ = οὐκέτι)
πάσασθαι: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to eat of’
πέλοντο: πέλομαι — be, become; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐγίγνοντο)
πέμπον: πέμπω — send, convey; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπον)
πίνετο: πίνω — drink; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίνετο): ’was drunk’
παύροισι: παῦρος — few, little; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’few’
περικαλλὲς: περικαλλής — very beautiful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
περσεφόνεια: Περσεφόνεια — Persephone, queen of the dead; fem. nom. sg.
πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολλοῖσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic πολλοῖς): ’for many’
προδόμῳ: πρόδομος — forecourt, front part of the house; masc. dat. sg.
προταμὼν: προτέμνω — cut forward, cut off; aor. 2 part. masc. nom. sg., epic τάμ- (= Attic προτεμών)
πρόχνυ: πρόχνυ — utterly, completely; adv., of uncertain origin (perhaps ’down on the knees’)
πυκινῶς: πυκινός — close-packed, shrewd, well-considered; adv. πυκινῶς: ’shrewdly, closely’
σανίδας: σανίς — board, plank, door-leaf; fem. acc. pl.
στυγερὰς: στυγερός — hateful, dreaded, loathsome; fem. acc. pl.
σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
σῦν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, hog; masc./fem. acc. sg.
τέλεσσαν: τελέω — accomplish, finish; aor. 3 pl., epic σσ, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέλεσαν)
τανύοντο: τανύω — stretch, strain; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’stretched themselves, strained’
τελέθουσι: τελέθω — come to be, become, be; pres. 3 pl.
τηλύγετον: τηλύγετος — late-born, or on another view tenderly loved (meaning disputed); masc. acc. sg.
φαίδιμ: φαίδιμος — gleaming, glorious (epic epithet of heroes); masc. voc. sg., elided (φαίδιμ’ = φαίδιμε)
φεῦγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφευγον): ’I fled’
φιλέων: φιλέω — love, treat kindly, welcome; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλῶν)
χαλεπαίνοι: χαλεπαίνω — be fierce, rage (of weather); pres. opt. 3 sg., general condition · also be angry, take offence (of a person); pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: οὐκ ἂν … χαλεπαίνοι ’no one should take offence’
ψιλὴν: ψιλός — bare, stripped; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγανῇσι: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀγαναῖς)
ἀκούοντος: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with the pronoun μευ: ’as I listen’
ἀλέγουσι: ἀλέγω — care for, heed, see to; pres. 3 pl., + acc.
ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard plot; gen. sg.
ἀμειβόμενοι: ἀμείβομαι — take turns, alternate; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
ἀναίνετο: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disdain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠναίνετο): ‘refused’
ἀναπρήσας: ἀναπρήθω — make burst out, blow up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bursting out (into tears)’
ἀποτίσῃ: ἀποτίνω — pay back, atone for; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’he may pay for’
ἀριπρεπέες: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀριπρεπεῖς)
ἀρτίπος: ἀρτίπους — sound of foot, with sound feet; masc. nom. sg.
ἀφνειὸν: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’a wealthy house’
ἁλώῃ: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἁλῷ), with κε: ’may be caught’
ἁμάρτῃ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, err, do wrong; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause without κε: ’whoever errs’
ἄναχθ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἄναχθ’ = ἄνακτα, with ἑόν): ’lord’
ἄνθρωποι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. nom. pl.
ἐμήν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐμοῖσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; adj., masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἐξετέλειον: ἐκτελέω — bring fully to completion, fulfil; impf. 3 pl., augmented (ἐκ- becomes ἐξ- before the augment): ’were bringing to fulfillment’
ἐξικόμην: ἐξικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg., with κε, unreal past: ’I should have reached’
ἐπιείκελ: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐπιείκελ’ = ἐπιείκελε)
ἐπώνυμον: ἐπώνυμος — named, bearing a name (whether it fits or means anything is uncertain); neut. nom. sg., in apposition to ὄνομα
ἐρινῦς: Ἐρινύς — a Fury, avenging spirit that answers a parent’s curse; fem. acc. pl.
ἑρκίον: ἑρκίον — fence, enclosing wall; neut. acc. sg. (diminutive of ἕρκος)
ἔθηκα: τίθημι — put, place; make (so-and-so); aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I made (you dear to)’
ἔκλυεν: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 3 sg.
ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
ἔρεξα: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 sg.
ἔσβη: σβέννυμι — quench, extinguish; pass./intr. aor. 3 sg. ἔσβη, root aorist: ’died out, was quenched’ (of the wind, not fire)
ἔσφαζον: σφάζω — slaughter; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were slaughtering’
ἔται: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman (not to be confused with ἔτος ’year’); masc. nom. pl.
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); fem. acc. pl.
ἤνωγον: ἄνωγα — order, bid, urge (perf. with pres. sense); impf. 3 pl. ἤνωγον, epic: ’they urged’
ἵκοι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., conditional/potential optative: ’should come upon’ (of need, χρειὼ ... ἵκοι)
ὁμοιΐου: ὁμοίϊος (= ὅμοιος) — impartial, common to both sides (sense disputed); masc. gen. sg., with πολέμοιο
ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented · also ’receive as a host, welcome’ (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’) · also ’await, lie in wait for’, of woe awaiting a man (ἔτι γάρ νύ με πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’for woe still awaited me’); the form is in fact augmented (ὑπ-έ-δεκτο, 2nd aor.)
ὠρίνετο: ὀρίνω — stir up, agitate; impf. 3 sg. pass., augmented: ’was stirred, was shaken’
ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented
